content.title: Marvel Rivals Season 7 Release Date & Exact Start Times
content.text: Marvel Rivals continues to roll out new seasonal content at a steady pace, and Season 7 is right around the corner. After the previous update introduced new heroes and balance changes, the next season is expected to shift the spotlight toward a heist-themed update featuring one of Spider-Man’s most well-known rivals.Season 6 made a lot of noise thanks to the arrival of Deadpool, giving players a new aggressive playstyle and shaking up the meta. Season 7 looks set to keep the momentum going with new characters, fresh balance changes, and another round of seasonal content.For players waiting to jump into the next update, here is the expected release date and the exact times when Season 7 should go live around the world.Marvel Rivals Season 7 Release DateSeason 7 of Marvel Rivals is expected to launch on March 20, 2026.Most seasons in Marvel Rivals follow roughly a one-month cycle. Based on that pattern, some players initially expected the next update around March 15. However, the developers appear to be giving this update a bit more development time, likely to prepare additional content and balance changes.Marvel Rivals Season 7 Release Date & Exact Start TimesThe upcoming season is expected to introduce Black Cat as a new playable hero. Known for her stealth, agility, and high-risk playstyle, Black Cat could bring a different approach to the game’s team compositions.There are also early indications that White Fox may arrive shortly after in a mid-season update, which would likely land around Season 7.5 if the current seasonal structure continues.As with previous updates, the new season will also likely include:Balance adjustments to existing heroesNew cosmetics and seasonal rewardsBattle Pass progression resetMeta changes as players test new team combinationsMarvel Rivals Season 7 Start TimesWhile the developers have not officially confirmed the exact launch time, previous Marvel Rivals updates have followed a consistent schedule. Based on that pattern, Season 7 is expected to go live at 3:00 AM PT on March 20, 2026.Here are the expected release times for major regions:Region / Time ZoneMarvel Rivals Season 7 Release TimePacific Time (PT)3:00 AM — March 20Central Time (CT)5:00 AM — March 20Eastern Time (ET)6:00 AM — March 20Brasilia Time (BRT)7:00 AM — March 20Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)10:00 AM — March 20China Standard Time (CST)6:00 PM — March 20Korean Standard Time (KST)7:00 PM — March 20Japan Standard Time (JST)7:00 PM — March 20Australian Eastern Time (AET)9:00 PM — March 20New Zealand Daylight Time (NZDT)11:00 PM — March 20What To Expect From Season 7A new season is usually when Marvel Rivals feels the most fresh. Balance updates tend to reshape the meta, and the addition of new heroes often changes how teams approach objectives and fights.If Black Cat does arrive at the start of Season 7, players can expect more stealth-focused gameplay and aggressive flanking strategies. Combined with possible hero adjustments from Season 6, the competitive landscape could shift quickly in the first few weeks.For now, players only need to wait until March 20 to see everything the new season brings.
